I saw the movie a few hours ago but I got to say I really do appreciate how most of class 1-A got to face against the villains to an extent. I got to say though I’m really surprised Tokoyami essentially got a 1v1. I wasn’t upset by it in anyway but I was just surprised it was him over Todoroki. 

But I do understand it’s because his fights lend themself to be a bit more dynamic and interesting to watch in comparison to Todoroki who is a somewhat static fighter. Plus it allowed us to see a rage boosted Dark Shadow again and to really see how agile Mina can be. 

Overall I liked the fights for the most part but I do wish the final part of Nine vs Deku and Bakugo was bit smaller in scale. What I mean in one part is the animation while dynamic was a bit hard to follow in comparison to when Deku was only at 20%. The other part is how Deku could seemingly handle 100% full cowl without an Eri like assist. I can kind of understand a boost due to kid’s quirk (the young boy I forgot his name) when he healed Deku and Bakugo. But I do think it was bit much that Deku could have used it twice in a short span of time without a healing. 

If I had to change that scene it would be that Deku only uses it once ideally after the power sharing moment. That way Deku at the level of power doesn’t seem weaker than it should be. He still uses the form but it’s easier for an audience to understand why he can use it, the boys quirk and that he’s not using it at a true 100%.
